media-feature-range-notation.message: Use max-width/min-width, not range notation. Safari below 16.4 ignores an entire query it cannot parse, so `(width <= 760px)` would drop the mobile layout on those devices rather than degrade.

selector-not-notation.message: One selector per :not(). A selector list inside :not() needs Safari 16.4; older Safari drops the whole rule rather than the one selector.

property-no-vendor-prefix.message: The -webkit- mask properties are kept: Safari only dropped the prefix in 15.4, and the unprefixed form alone leaves the icon masks unapplied on older iOS.

custom-property-pattern.message: Custom property names are kebab-case; WordPress preset vars (--wp--preset--*) use double hyphens between segments.

selector-class-pattern.message: Class names must be lowercase, may contain digits, hyphens, or underscores (underscores accommodate WordPress core classes like .current_page_item).
